title.zh: 榫构华夏 · Timber Craft Lab

description: 六件中国传统建筑结构的可拆解 3D 教学模型清单（机器可读）。所有几何由代码程序化生成，均为教学示意模型，非测绘级复原；材质与比例为教学表达，非考古数据。

disclaimer.zh: 教学示意，非施工/工程模型。六件模型均为程序化生成的示意模型，非测绘级复原；材质与比例为教学表达，非考古数据。
disclaimer.en: Teaching diagram, not a construction or engineering model. All six models are procedurally generated schematic models, not surveyed reconstructions; materials and proportions are pedagogical expressions, not archaeological data.

forceArrowsNote.zh: 受力箭头为传力路径的定性说明，非结构计算结果。
forceArrowsNote.en: Force arrows are a qualitative indication of load paths, not the result of a structural calculation.

axes.x: 面阔（栱 / 檩 / 椽沿此向）
axes.z: 进深（翘 / 昂 / 枋沿此向，+Z 为檐外）

conventions.coordinateSystem: three.js 右手系，Y 轴向上
conventions.partOrder: order 为 0 起升序，表达装配次序

usage.mechanism: 构建期拷贝：复制 18 的 src/core/ + src/models/ 与 fonts/，import 模型描述符并 registerModel()；若主站不引入 three，则改用 exportGLBBuffer(id) 取预导出 GLB（仓库内不预生成 .glb）。
usage.notMonorepo: 16—19 为各自独立目录，非 monorepo 单包；不得用 npm 互相依赖，只能拷贝源码或取产物。

subtitle.zh: 清式单翘单昂五踩柱头科 · 层叠出跳的木制节点
subtitle.en: Qing-style single-gong single-ang, five-step column-head set

summary.zh: 斗栱是中国木构屋檐下的一整套叠木节点：方木块「斗」承托短枋木「栱」，栱再层层向外挑出，把屋檐深远地伸到柱心之外。它原本是真正的承重结构——荷载一级级传到柱上；明清以后逐渐缩小，主要剩下装饰作用。
summary.en: Dougong is a layered timber bracket set under the eaves. Square blocks called "dou" carry short arms called "gong", which project outward in steps and carry the deep overhanging roof. It was genuinely structural: loads were relayed step by step down to the column. From the Ming and Qing dynasties onward it shrank and became mainly decorative.

era.zh: 唐宋成熟，明清渐变为装饰
era.en: Mature in Tang–Song, decorative from Ming–Qing

scaleNote.zh: 教学示意，非施工/工程模型；斗口比例与出跳数已简化，前后对称做法只详列檐外一侧。
scaleNote.en: Teaching diagram — not a construction or engineering model; doukou proportions and step counts are simplified, and only the eave side of the symmetric set is detailed.

name.en: Hall of Supreme Harmony, Forbidden City

subtitle.zh: 燕尾榫 · 透榫 · 半榫 · 馒头榫 · 不用一根钉子
subtitle.en: Dovetail · Through tenon · Half lap · Round tenon — no nails at all

summary.zh: 榫是凸出的榫头，卯是凹进的卯眼，两者咬合即为榫卯。中国古建筑不用铁钉把构件连成一体，而是让构件之间彼此"长在一起"：榫卯既限制构件在各方向上的转动，又保留微量变形，使整座木构在地震中可以晃动而少受破坏。
summary.en: A tenon is the protruding tongue, a mortise the receiving socket; locked together they form a joint. Chinese timber buildings were assembled without iron nails — the pieces grow into one another. The joint restrains movement in every direction yet still allows slight flex, so a timber frame can sway in an earthquake instead of shattering.

era.zh: 新石器时代已出现，宋代《营造法式》定型
era.en: Present since the Neolithic; codified in the Song Yingzao Fashi

region.zh: 中国木构建筑与明式家具
region.en: Chinese timber architecture and Ming-style furniture

scaleNote.zh: 教学示意，非施工/工程模型；卯口为便于观察作通直处理，与实物榫头的细微斜度有别。
scaleNote.en: Teaching diagram — not a construction or engineering model; mortises are drawn straight-through for legibility rather than with the subtle draft of a real tenon.

subtitle.zh: 柱上抬梁，梁上立瓜柱，层层叠起屋架
subtitle.en: Beams raised on columns, dwarf posts lifting the frame step by step

summary.zh: 抬梁式的逻辑是"立柱承梁、梁上承檩"：柱头立大梁，梁上立瓜柱，瓜柱上再置二梁、三架梁，层层缩短、层层抬高，脊瓜柱托起脊檩。檩上搁椽、椽上铺屋面，荷载自屋面经椽、檩、梁架下传至柱与台基。春秋时期形成，唐宋成熟，多见于北方官式殿宇；柱距可达三至五米，室内开阔，但梁料巨大。
summary.en: The post-and-beam logic is "columns carry beams, beams carry purlins": a main beam rests on the column heads, dwarf posts stand on it, and successively shorter beams are stacked above until a ridge post lifts the ridge purlin. Rafters lie on the purlins and the roof surface lies on the rafters, so the load runs roof → rafter → purlin → beam frame → column → plinth. The system appeared in the Spring and Autumn period and matured in Tang–Song times, and is common in northern official halls, where wide column spacing opens the interior at the cost of very large timbers.

era.en: Formed in the Spring & Autumn period, mature in Tang–Song

region.zh: 北方官式建筑与佛寺殿宇
region.en: Northern official architecture and temple halls

name.zh: 嵩山少林寺（常住院、塔林）

subtitle.zh: 密柱直承檩条，穿枋横贯拉结
subtitle.en: Dense columns carry the purlins; through-ties bind the row

summary.zh: 穿斗式的逻辑是"柱承檩"：柱沿进深方向密排，每根柱头直接顶住一根檩条，檩上搁椽、椽上铺屋面。穿枋自柱身横穿而过，只起拉结与稳定作用，并不承担竖向荷载，因此檩的重量完全由柱承担、逐级下传至台基。常有隔柱落地为"断柱"，其余柱脚落在穿枋上。工匠在地上绑好柱与枋再整排竖立，故称"立帖"。汉代已成熟，今多见于川渝、湘赣、闽粤及长江中下游的乡土建筑；构件小、造价低、抗风好，代价是柱子多、内部空间被分割。
summary.en: The column-and-tie logic is "columns carry purlins": the columns stand closely spaced along the depth of the building and each column head directly carries one purlin, on which the rafters and then the roof surface rest. The through-ties pass horizontally through the columns and do nothing but bind and stabilise the row, so all vertical load goes through the columns down to the plinth. Often only every other column reaches the ground as a "broken column", the rest resting on the ties. Builders assemble the columns and ties flat on the ground and then raise the whole frame, hence the name "standing a bay". The system was mature by the Han dynasty and is still used in vernacular building in Sichuan, Chongqing, Hunan, Jiangxi, Fujian, Guangdong and the middle-lower Yangtze: small members, low cost and good wind resistance, at the price of many columns chopping up the interior.

era.en: Mature by the Han dynasty, still in use today

region.zh: 南方乡土建筑：川渝、湘赣、闽粤与长江中下游
region.en: Southern vernacular: Sichuan–Chongqing, Hunan–Jiangxi, Fujian–Guangdong, middle-lower Yangtze

subtitle.zh: 赵州桥式坦弧主拱 · 两侧敞肩小拱 · 浅基础浅桥台
subtitle.en: Zhaozhou-type segmental arch · open shoulders · shallow abutments

summary.zh: 主拱是矢跨比约 1:5 的坦弧（不是半圆），由 28 道并列拱券纵向砌筑而成，券圈自外向内收分，圈间以铁拉杆与腰铁拉结。拱肩开两座小拱，既减重约 700 吨、又增大泄洪断面。桥台仅 1.55 m 高，全桥荷载以受压方式沿拱圈传到两岸。
summary.en: The main arch is a shallow segmental arc (rise-to-span ≈ 1:5, not a semicircle) built from 28 rings laid side by side, tapered so the rings lean on each other and bound by iron ties and cramps. Two small arches open each shoulder, saving some 700 t of stone and enlarging the flood opening. The abutments are only 1.55 m deep; the load travels as compression through the rings into the banks.

era.zh: 隋代开皇末年（公元 595–605 年），匠人李春造
era.en: Sui dynasty (c. 595–605 CE), by the craftsman Li Chun

region.zh: 河北赵县 · 赵州桥（安济桥）

scaleNote.en: Teaching diagram — not a construction or engineering model: real dimensions, uniformly scaled to 1 unit = 4 m. Five of the 28 parallel rings are shown and the railing is indicative — not a construction drawing.

subtitle.zh: 福建圆楼 180° 剖面 · 夯土外墙 · 楼中有楼
subtitle.en: Fujian round tulou, 180° section · rammed-earth walls · building within a building

summary.zh: 外墙用熟土分层夯筑，底厚 1–2 m、向上收分到 0.4–0.8 m，既承重又御敌；墙内埋杉木枝条作墙骨。楼内环环相套：外圈居最底层，环形走廊串起各个房间，内环再围出一座小楼，中心天井与祖堂落在同一条轴线上。
summary.en: The outer wall is rammed in layers of sticky local earth, 1–2 m thick at the base and tapered to 0.4–0.8 m at the top, carrying the loads and the defence; cedar laths are buried in the earth as wall bones. Inside, ring after ring: the outer ring holds the kitchens, stores and pens, a ring corridor links the rooms, an inner ring encloses a smaller building, and the courtyard with the ancestral hall sits on the same axis as the gate.

era.zh: 宋末至明清，2008 年列入世界遗产
era.en: Song–Ming to Qing, inscribed UNESCO World Heritage in 2008

region.zh: 福建永定、南靖、华安及广东梅州

scaleNote.zh: 教学示意，非施工/工程模型：以直径约 60 m 的四层圆楼为例，剖去一半，统一缩为 1 单位 = 4 米；房间划分、枪眼与墙骨为示意，非施工图。
scaleNote.en: Teaching diagram — not a construction or engineering model: a four-storey round tulou of about 60 m diameter, cut in half and scaled to 1 unit = 4 m. Room divisions, gun holes and wall bones are indicative, not a construction drawing.
